definitions.gloss: display shelf; display rack; exhibition shelf
definitions.explanation: A shelf or rack used to display merchandise in stores, museums, or exhibitions. Unlike a showcase, it is typically open without glass enclosure.

examples.japanese: {陳列棚|ちんれつだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: To arrange products on the display shelf.
I can't reach the books on the upper shelf of the display rack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陳列棚|ちんれつだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばした→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: We placed the new products on a display shelf in a prominent location and increased sales.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in retail and exhibition contexts. The base word ⟦{陳列|ちんれつ}→陳列：17560_chinretsu⟧ means display or exhibition. More formal than simply saying ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ (shelf).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陳列棚|ちんれつだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧ (to line up on a display shelf)
- {陳列棚|ちんれつだな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧ (to organize the display shelf)
- {陳列棚|ちんれつだな}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take from the display shelf)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ショーケース→ショーケース：17995_shookeesu⟧: showcase — an enclosed glass display case
- ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧: shelf — the general word for any shelf
